coverage.note: The feature surface of MCP 2026-07-28, enumerated from the released specification. This file is the denominator: it is what the protocol defines, independent of what we have measured. A feature with a hand-authored file in capabilities/ is measured; every other feature is published as a row whose cells are all 'u'. Coverage is therefore a fact the build computes, not a claim the site makes.
omissions: Skills over MCP is not listed. The spec index advertises it, but /extensions/skills/overview 404s and the only published material is a working-group charter, so there is no wire contract to measure against.

Features removed in this revision (initialize, ping, logging/setLevel, resources/subscribe, notifications/roots/list_changed, Mcp-Session-Id, SSE resumability) are absent by design. They belong to the 2025-11-25 snapshot, not this one.
